items.title_en: Kimi K3 is now live
items.title_zh: Kimi K3 现已上线
items.summary_en: Kimi has released K3, a major new version. It promises improved performance and new capabilities, signaling continued investment in the product line for developers and users.
items.summary_zh: Kimi 已发布 K3 版本，带来性能提升与新功能。此次上线显示该产品线持续投资，开发者与用户应关注对工作流与集成的影响。

items.title_en: Microsoft Comic Chat is now open source
items.title_zh: 微软 Comic Chat 现已开源
items.summary_en: Microsoft released the classic Comic Chat client as open source, reviving a piece of 1990s online chat UI and protocol. The release provides a sandbox for experimentation with vintage software, preserving artifacts and teaching UX evolution.
items.summary_zh: 微软将经典的 Comic Chat 客户端开源，重现了 1990 年代的在线聊天界面和协议。此次发布为复古软件的实验、保存与研究提供了机会，也揭示了聊天用户体验的演变。

items.title_en: Decoy Font
items.title_zh: Decoy 字体
items.summary_en: Decoy Font is an experimental typeface designed to confuse automated readers and OCR systems by mapping glyphs in unusual ways. It highlights typography’s impact on AI text detectors and reveals current recognition limits.
items.summary_zh: Decoy 字体是一种实验性字体，通过以异常的方式映射字形来混淆自动识别系统与 OCR。它揭示排版对 AI 文本检测的影响与当前识别能力的边界。

items.title_en: Sony deletes more movies from the accounts of people who ‘bought’ them
items.title_zh: 索尼再次从购买者账户中删除多部电影
items.summary_en: Sony has removed additional titles from users’ digital libraries after purchase, prompting questions about ownership, DRM, and what it means to 'own' digital media. The incident spotlights ongoing tensions in rights, licensing, and user trust.
items.summary_zh: 索尼再次从已购买用户的数字库中删除多部电影，引发关于数字所有权、DRM 与所有权概念的讨论。此事凸显版权、许可与用户信任之间的张力。

items.title_en: OnePlus halts operations in USA and Europe
items.title_zh: OnePlus 在美国与欧洲暂停运营
items.summary_en: OnePlus halted operations in the US and Europe, signaling a strategic retreat amid regulatory, market, or supply-chain pressures. The move underscores how mid-market hardware brands navigate geopolitical tensions and post-pandemic demand shifts.
items.summary_zh: OnePlus 宣布在美国与欧洲暂停运营，背后或涉及监管、市场与供应链压力。此举反映中端硬件品牌在地缘政治紧张与后疫情需求变化中的策略调整。

items.title_en: 42% of adults rely on their parents for financial support
items.title_zh: 有 42% 的成年人依赖父母提供经济支持
items.summary_en: A CNBC-backed piece highlights that 42% of adults still depend on their parents for financial support. The statistic underscores economic fragility and generational shifts that could influence consumer tech usage and financial planning.
items.summary_zh: 报道指出约 42% 的成年人仍依赖父母提供财政支持，反映经济脆弱性与代际变化，可能影响消费科技偏好与理财规划。

items.title_en: Detecting LLM-Generated Texts with “Classical” Machine Learning
items.title_zh: 用传统机器学习检测大语言模型生成文本
items.summary_en: Even with powerful LLMs, traditional machine learning classifiers can help detect AI-generated text using features like syntax patterns and punctuation. The approach often provides interpretable signals that complement neural detectors.
items.summary_zh: 即使面对强大的大语言模型，传统机器学习分类器也能通过句法模式、标点等特征识别 AI 生成文本，提供可解释的信号，常与神经检测相互补充。

items.title_en: How Our Rust-to-Zig Rewrite Is Going
items.title_zh: 我们的 Rust 转 Zig 重写进展
items.summary_en: Progress update on rewriting a Rust codebase in Zig, detailing early results, design choices, and remaining hurdles. It outlines potential gains in memory safety, binary size, and cross-platform portability while acknowledging migration complexity.
items.summary_zh: 本文更新了将 Rust 代码库改写为 Zig 的进展，介绍关键设计取舍、初步成果与尚待解决的挑战。讨论了在内存安全、二进制大小和跨平台可移植性方面的潜在收益，同时也强调迁移的复杂性。

items.title_en: NotebookLM is now Gemini Notebook
items.title_zh: NotebookLM 现名为 Gemini Notebook
items.summary_en: Google rebrands NotebookLM as Gemini Notebook and ties it more closely to the Gemini AI ecosystem, signaling deeper integration for note-taking, research, and AI-assisted idea capture.
items.summary_zh: Google 将 NotebookLM 重命名为 Gemini Notebook，并与 Gemini AI 生态系统更紧密地整合，强化笔记、研究与 AI 辅助记录的能力。

items.title_en: The lost joy of music piracy
items.title_zh: 音乐盗版的逝去乐趣
items.summary_en: Streaming turned music into a predictable, licensed product, draining the anarchic joy of early piracy. The piece reflects on how the pirate-era culture created camaraderie and discovery, and asks what we lose when access becomes commodified.
items.summary_zh: 流媒体让音乐变成可控的授权商品，削弱了早期盗版带来的狂热和社区感。本文回顾那段盗版文化如何塑造了发现与分享的乐趣，并讨论当下更易获取的市场会让我们错过哪些宝贵的文化体验。

items.title_en: Photos of items from families in different countries with different incomes
items.title_zh: 不同国家、不同收入家庭的物品照片
items.summary_en: Gapminder's Dollar Street project juxtaposes everyday items across families with different incomes and countries, offering a visual dataset to study material reality and inequality.
items.summary_zh: Gapminder 的 Dollar Street 项目用不同收入与国家的家庭日常物品照片对比，提供直观的数据集以研究物质生活差异与不平等。

items.title_en: Inkling: Our Open-Weights Model
items.title_zh: Inkling：我们的开源权重模型
items.summary_en: Inkling is Thinking Machines' open-weights model. It signals a broader push toward transparent, testable architectures. Open weights enable researchers to compare methods and stress-test safety features, potentially accelerating progress while requiring thoughtful governance.
items.summary_zh: Inkling 是 Thinking Machines 的开源权重模型。这体现了对透明、可测试架构的推进。开源权重便于研究者对比方法、测试安全性，但也需要谨慎治理以防滥用。

items.title_en: Goes-19 weather satellite enters Safe Hold mode
items.title_zh: GOES-19 天气卫星进入安全待机模式
items.summary_en: GOES-19 has entered Safe Hold mode after a detected anomaly, pausing normal ops. In Safe Hold, the satellite conserves power and awaits ground control to restore full operations, potentially reducing near-term weather data.
items.summary_zh: GOES-19 天气卫星因检测到异常进入安全待机模式，暂停常规操作。处于安全待机状态时，卫星会节省能源并等待地面控制重新启动全性能作业，可能短暂影响近实时天气数据的获取。

items.title_en: German AI consortium releases Soofi S, an open 30B model that tops benchmarks
items.title_zh: 德国 AI 联盟发布 Soofi S：开源 30B 模型，在基准测试中领先
items.summary_en: Germany's AI consortium releases Soofi S, an open 30B model that tops benchmarks in English and German, underscoring the vitality of open-weight multilingual models and challenging incumbents.
items.summary_zh: 德国 AI 联盟发布 Soofi S，这是一个开源的 30B 模型，在英语和德语基准测试中名列前茅，凸显开源权重多语言模型的活力并对 incumbents 构成挑战。

items.title_en: Immersive Linear Algebra Book with Interactive Figures (2015)
items.title_zh: 带交互图的沉浸式线性代数书（2015）
items.summary_en: Immersive Linear Algebra, a 2015 project, offers interactive figures to explore linear algebra concepts, foreshadowing the rise of web-based math visualization.
items.summary_zh: 2015 年的沉浸式线性代数书通过互动图形讲解概念，预示了网页化数学可视化的崛起。

items.title_en: Ente – Opening Our Books
items.title_zh: Ente：公开我们的账本
items.summary_en: Ente is opening its books to transparency, inviting public scrutiny of its finances and governance. The move could build trust and reveal how resources are allocated.
items.summary_zh: Ente 正在公开账本以实现透明化，邀请公众审阅财务与治理情况。此举有助于提升信任度，并揭示资源分配的细节。

items.title_en: Where are YC founders now? OpenAI and Anthropic, mostly
items.title_zh: YC 创业者现在在哪？OpenAI 与 Anthropic 为主
items.summary_en: A look at what YC-alumni founders are doing today, with a focus on leaders behind OpenAI and Anthropic, illustrating how startup veterans pivot into leading AI labs and ventures. It sheds light on talent flows in the AI ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 追踪 YC 创业者如今的去向，聚焦 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 背后的创始人，揭示初创老兵如何转型为 AI 实验室或新企业的领军人物，以及人才在 AI 生态中的流动。

items.title_en: Guide to data tools landscape for developers
items.title_zh: 开发者的数据工具生态指南
items.summary_en: A practical guide mapping the landscape of data tooling for developers, covering ingestion, storage, processing, and visualization. It helps engineers choose stacks and understand trade-offs between simplicity and scale.
items.summary_zh: 这份实用指南梳理了开发者在数据领域可用的工具生态，涵盖数据获取、存储、处理和可视化等环节，帮助工程师在不同场景中权衡简易性与扩展性。

items.title_en: The LLM Critics Are Right. I Use LLMs Anyway
items.title_zh: LLM 的批评者说得对，我仍然在使用 LLM
items.summary_en: The author acknowledges criticisms of LLMs but argues practical value justifies continued use, perhaps with safeguards and mindful expectations. It discusses balancing limitations with productive applications, and how to integrate LLMs responsibly.
items.summary_zh: 作者承认对 LLM 的批评，但认为在有保障和谨慎期望的前提下，仍然能从中获益，并讨论如何在实际应用中平衡局限性与生产力，以及负责任地使用 LLM。

items.title_en: Let's Build PlanetScale from Scratch: Infrastructure
items.title_zh: 从零开始探建 PlanetScale：基础设施
items.summary_en: An infrastructure-focused write-up explains how to build a PlanetScale-like backend from scratch, covering sharding, migrations, and schema management. It offers practical patterns for a scalable, multi-tenant database stack.
items.summary_zh: 本文从零开始探讨构建类似 PlanetScale 的基础设施，涉及分片、迁移与模式管理等要点，提供面向高可用和多租户场景的实用设计范式。

items.title_en: How to Train a Gen AI Kick Drum Model on Your Old Linux Desktop with 6GB VRAM
items.title_zh: 在 6GB VRAM 的旧 Linux 桌面上训练生成式 AI 的踢鼓模型
items.summary_en: A guide showing how to train a generative AI kick-drum model on a consumer-grade GPU (6GB VRAM) using compact architectures and optimization tricks. It demonstrates that hobbyist hardware can still produce tangible audio synthesis with the right techniques.
items.summary_zh: 一篇指南展示如何在仅有 6GB VRAM 的消费级显卡上，结合紧凑架构与优化技巧，训练一个踢鼓声生成模型。通过这些方法，业余硬件也能实现可用的音频合成。

items.title_en: Grok Build is open source
items.title_zh: Grok Build 开源
items.summary_en: Grok Build is now open source, inviting community contributions and enabling users to inspect and extend the build tooling.
items.summary_zh: Grok Build 现已开源，鼓励社区贡献，让开发者可以查看、修改并扩展构建工具链。

items.title_en: Show HN: Leaves – A text-UI disk usage treemap visualizer
items.title_zh: Leaves：文本 UI 的磁盘使用树状图可视化工具
items.summary_en: Leaves is a text-user-interface tool that renders a disk-usage treemap in the terminal, offering a compact, navigable view of space distribution without a GUI.
items.summary_zh: Leaves 是一个文本 UI 的磁盘使用树状图可视化工具，在终端中呈现磁盘空间分布，省去 GUI 的需要，便于在终端环境下快速定位大文件。

items.title_en: 56,000 lines of DOOM, in a language I made up
items.title_zh: 用我自创的语言实现的 56,000 行 DOOM 代码
items.summary_en: 56,000 lines of DOOM implemented in a language the author designed demonstrates the feasibility of building large games in a personal language and offers insights into language design trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 作者用自创语言实现了约 56,000 行 DOOM 的代码，展示在自制语言中开发大型游戏的可行性，并提供语言设计取舍的洞见。

items.title_en: Sleep regularity is a stronger predictor of mortality risk than sleep duration (2023)
items.title_zh: 睡眠规律性比睡眠时长更能预测死亡风险
items.summary_en: New research suggests that how regularly you sleep predicts mortality risk more strongly than total sleep duration. Using long-term wearable data, the study links consistent sleep timing with better health outcomes, independent of hours slept. The finding shifts emphasis toward regular schedules as a health strategy and dovetails with consumer wellness tech.
items.summary_zh: 最新研究表明，睡眠时间的规律性与死亡风险的相关性比总睡眠时长更强。通过长期可穿戴设备数据，研究发现稳定的睡眠时序与更好的健康结果相关，且与实际睡眠时长无关。该发现将健康策略的重点从睡眠时长转向规律作息，并与可穿戴健康科技的发展相吻合。

items.title_en: If you want to create a button from scratch, you must first create the universe
items.title_zh: 如果你想从零开始设计一个按钮，首先要创造宇宙
items.summary_en: The post argues that true accessibility requires rethinking the button from its foundations—semantics, roles, and keyboard focus—before styling. It presents a mental model for designing controls that are usable by everyone, from screen readers to assistive tech.
items.summary_zh: 作者主张要从根本上重新设计无障碍按钮，先明确语义、角色和键盘聚焦，再考虑样式。给出一套面向屏幕阅读器等辅助技术的设计思路，帮助开发者从一开始就实现真正可用的控件。

items.title_en: Show HN: A modern port of Linux to a ten-year-old QWERTY phone
items.title_zh: Show HN：将现代 Linux 端口移植到十年旧的 QWERTY 手机
items.summary_en: A modern Linux port runs on a ten-year-old QWERTY phone, showing off the potential and limits of resurrecting full OS usability on old hardware. It highlights hobbyist ingenuity and hardware-software integration challenges.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：将现代 Linux 端口移植到十年前的 QWERTY 手机，展示在老旧硬件上实现完整操作系统的潜力与局限，体现爱好者的巧思及软硬件协同挑战。

items.title_en: SQLite should have (Rust-style) editions
items.title_zh: SQLite 应该有（像 Rust 那样的） Edition
items.summary_en: SQLite would benefit from edition-style feature versions to manage incompatible changes and new capabilities. Editions could preserve stable behavior while enabling newer features to be adopted gradually.
items.summary_zh: 作者提出让 SQLite 引入类似 Rust 版本的 Edition，以在兼容性变更和新功能之间提供清晰的界限。通过 Editions，用户可在保持稳定行为的同时，逐步引入更先进的功能。

items.title_en: 1,300 Beautiful Wildlife Illustrations from the 19th Century Now Restored
items.title_zh: 19世纪1300幅美丽野生动物插图现已修复
items.summary_en: A vast restoration project brings 1,300 19th-century wildlife illustrations back to life, digitized for study and enjoyment. The collection highlights historical natural history art and the value of restoration work for access and education.
items.summary_zh: 修复工作让19世纪1300幅野生动物插图重现光彩，数字化版本便于研究与公众欣赏。展示修复在保护美术与自然史资料、提升可访问性方面的价值。

items.title_en: Schema Harness Achieves ~99% on Arc‑AGI‑3 Public
items.title_zh: Schema Harness 在 Arc-AGI-3 公共基准上约 99%
items.summary_en: Schema Harness claims around 99% performance on Arc-AGI-3 public benchmark, signaling strong results for schema-based reasoning systems and adding to the debate about scaling data-guided AI.
items.summary_zh: Schema Harness 在 Arc-AGI-3 公共基准上约获 99% 的表现，显示基于模式推理系统的强劲性能，并为数据驱动 AI 的扩展性讨论提供新证据。

items.title_en: Teen hackers who live streamed cyber-attack on TfL jailed
items.title_zh: 直播对 TfL 的青少年黑客被判监禁
items.summary_en: Two teenage hackers who livestreamed a cyber-attack on Transport for London were jailed. The case underscores the seriousness of cybercrime and the consequences of online public wrongdoing.
items.summary_zh: 两名青少年黑客因对伦敦交通局发动网络攻击并进行直播而被判刑。此案凸显网络犯罪的严重性以及在网上公开作恶的后果。

items.title_en: Agent-talk: Enabling coding agents to work together
items.title_zh: Agent-talk：让编码智能体协同工作
items.summary_en: Agent-talk is a framework enabling multiple coding agents to coordinate and collaborate on tasks, potentially improving automation efficiency and reducing deadlock through structured communication.
items.summary_zh: Agent-talk 提供一个框架，使多个编码智能体能够协同完成任务，通过结构化通信提升自动化效率并减少协作冲突。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Traceforce (YC S26) – Company-wide security monitoring for AI apps
items.title_zh: Traceforce（YC S26）— 面向全公司对 AI 应用的安全监控
items.summary_en: Traceforce is YC S26-backed security-monitoring startup for AI applications that aims to watch across an organization for misuse and data leakage. The product targets enterprise-scale governance as AI use expands.
items.summary_zh: Traceforce 是 YC S26 背景的 AI 应用安全监控初创公司，面向企业层面监控滥用与数据泄露。随着 AI 使用扩张，其治理需求日益突出。

items.title_en: 800 Canadian wildfires burning as air quality alerts extend to US
items.title_zh: 多地加拿大 800 起野火，空气质量警报扩展至美国
items.summary_en: Canada faces hundreds of wildfires with air-quality warnings creeping into the US, highlighting cross-border environmental impacts and the value of real-time monitoring.
items.summary_zh: 加拿大正经历数百起野火，空气质量警报蔓延至美国，凸显跨境环境影响及对实时监测工具的需求。

items.title_en: We're Building Postgres in Rust. Using the LLVM of Databases
items.title_zh: 用 Rust 构建 Postgres，借助数据库的 LLVM
items.summary_en: Turso's blog outlines building a Postgres-like database in Rust with an LLVM-backed backend, signaling a novel approach to performance and safety in database engines.
items.summary_zh: Turso 博客概述在 Rust 中构建类 Postgres 的数据库，后端借助 LLVM，展示在数据库引擎中以性能与安全性为目标的新方向。

items.title_en: Generative AI Is an Engineering Disaster
items.title_zh: 生成式 AI 的工程灾难
items.summary_en: An opinion piece arguing that generative AI exposes fundamental engineering challenges—data quality, system reliability, scaling, and governance—and calls for better tooling and lifecycle management to avoid brittle deployments.
items.summary_zh: 这篇观点文章认为生成式人工智能暴露了数据质量、系统可靠性、扩展性与治理等工程难题，呼吁改进工具链与生命周期管理，以避免脆弱的部署。

items.title_en: The rate at which Earth is absorbing energy is alarming climate scientists
items.title_zh: 地球吸收能量的速率令人担忧
items.summary_en: Scientists warn that Earth's energy absorption is accelerating, underscoring urgency for climate policy and robust data to project future warming.
items.summary_zh: 科学家警告地球吸收能量的速率正在加快，强调制定气候政策与获取可靠数据以预测未来变暖的紧迫性。

items.title_en: Reynard: A real Firefox web browser for iOS 13 or later
items.title_zh: Reynard：一个适用于 iOS 13 及以上版本的真实 Firefox 浏览器
items.summary_en: Reynard is a real Firefox-like browser for iOS 13+, showcasing open-source browser experimentation on Apple devices. It discusses architecture choices and the constraints that still shape mobile browsers on iOS.
items.summary_zh: Reynard 是一个面向 iOS 13+ 的真实浏览器实现，代表开源浏览器在苹果设备上的实验性探索。讨论架构选择与 iOS 的限制如何影响移动端浏览器的实现与隐私特性。

items.title_en: Governments, companies, nonprofits should invest in free, open source AI [pdf]
items.title_zh: 政府、企业、非营利组织应投资免费、开源的 AI
items.summary_en: A policy brief argues that free, open-source AI is essential for public innovation, transparency, and resilience against vendor lock-in by governments, companies, and nonprofits.
items.summary_zh: 报告主张政府、企业与非营利组织应投资免费、开源的 AI，以促进创新、透明度并提升对单一供应商的抵御能力。

items.title_en: Making 768 servers look like 1
items.title_zh: 让768台服务器看起来像一台
items.summary_en: A planning about presenting many physical servers as a single logical entity through unified orchestration and intelligent metadata, reducing management overhead. It demonstrates how operators can scale while keeping a simple control plane.
items.summary_zh: 通过统一的编排和元数据管理，把768台物理服务器对外呈现为一台的逻辑实体，降低运维复杂性。展示在大规模基础设施下保持简单控制平面的可行性与收益。

items.title_en: Bluesky Trademarks ATProto
items.title_zh: Bluesky 为 ATProto 注册商标
items.summary_en: Bluesky has trademarked ATProto, the protocol underpinning the platform’s API, signaling brand protection and potential standardization efforts.
items.summary_zh: Bluesky 已为 ATProto 注册商标，这一协议支撑着该平台的开放 API，显示出品牌保护和潜在标准化的动向。

items.title_en: Show HN: Firefox in WebAssembly
items.title_zh: Show HN：WebAssembly 实现的 Firefox
items.summary_en: Firefox in WebAssembly demonstrates a full browser running inside WebAssembly. It highlights WASM’s potential for portable, sandboxed execution of large apps—and the challenges of performance, feature parity, and memory usage. For developers, it signals where WASM could enable new deployment models, edge runtimes, or sandboxed alternatives to native binaries.
items.summary_zh: WebAssembly 实现的 Firefox 展示了一个完整浏览器在 WebAssembly 环境中的运行。它凸显了将在大规模应用端口化到可移植运行时的潜力，但也暴露了性能、功能对等与内存使用方面的挑战。对开发者而言，这宽广了 WASM 的潜在用例，如新的部署模型、边缘运行时或对原生二进制的沙箱替代方案。

items.title_en: Running Gemma 4 26B at 5 tokens/sec on a 13-year-old Xeon with no GPU
items.title_zh: 在无 GPU 的13 年老旧 Xeon 上以每秒 5 token 运行 Gemma-4-26B

items.title_en: GC shape stenciling in Go generics
items.title_zh: Go 泛型中的 GC 形状模板化
items.summary_en: GC shape stenciling describes how shaping generic code affects Go's garbage collector, enabling performance tuning by controlling allocation patterns without changing logic.
items.summary_zh: GC 形状模板化解释了如何通过塑造泛型代码来影响 Go 的垃圾回收行为，通过控制分配模式来优化性能，而不改变程序逻辑。

items.title_en: Panel meter calculator with floating point
items.title_zh: 带浮点运算的面板仪表计算器
items.summary_en: A panel meter calculator that supports floating-point arithmetic, addressing precision and edge cases common in electronics measurements.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个面向面板仪表的浮点计算器，聚焦数值精度与电子测量中的边界情况。文中讨论了实现中的数值处理与潜在误差。

items.title_en: The Last Picture Show: A Conversation with George Lucas
items.title_zh: 最后的放映：乔治·卢卡斯对话
items.summary_en: George Lucas reflects on filmmaking, technology, and the evolution of cinema, offering behind-the-scenes insight into practical effects, digital tools, and his creative philosophy. The chat blends industry history with thoughts on where film technology goes next.
items.summary_zh: 乔治·卢卡斯就电影创作、特效与数字化工具等话题展开对谈，回顾行业发展与技术演进。分享对电影技术未来方向的见解与个人哲学。

items.title_en: GSAP – A robust JavaScript animation library built for professionals
items.title_zh: GSAP：为专业人士打造的强大 JavaScript 动画库
items.summary_en: GSAP positions itself as a professional-grade animation toolkit for the modern web, with performance, compatibility, and expressive APIs across frameworks. It offers a practical look at why teams choose a dedicated animation library over ad-hoc CSS.
items.summary_zh: GSAP 提供面向专业开发者的强大 JavaScript 动画库，注重性能、跨框架兼容性和易用性。比较于纯 CSS 动画，它在复杂动画和控件同步方面更具优势。

items.title_en: CatchCat – Pokémon Go for Cats, IRL
items.title_zh: CatchCat：现实世界的猫咪版 Pokémon Go
items.summary_en: CatchCat connects cats with real-world play in a Pokémon Go–style experience, featuring cat-friendly playgrounds or tech-enabled cat toys. It highlights the playful convergence of gaming and pet-silicon hardware.
items.summary_zh: CatchCat 将猫咪游戏化为现实世界的探索活动，类似 Pokémon Go 的玩法结合猫咪友好场景。展示游戏化与宠物互动的有趣结合。

items.title_en: Let's build a simple interpreter for APL – part 1
items.title_zh: 让我们为 APL 构建一个简单的解释器 – 第一部分
items.summary_en: An introductory installment on building a simple APL interpreter, covering basic parsing, evaluation of array operations, and core language features.
items.summary_zh: 本系列的入门篇介绍如何从零构建一个简易的 APL 解释器，涵盖基本解析、数组运算的求值以及核心语言特性。

items.title_en: World-War-Ⅱ-era telephone line still in use in Upper Tanana Valley Alaska (2021)
items.title_zh: 二战时期的电话线路在阿拉斯加偏远山谷仍在使用（2021）
items.summary_en: A look at a World War II-era telephone line still in use in a remote Alaskan valley in 2021, illustrating the longevity of certain infrastructure and the realities of remote communications.
items.summary_zh: 讲述在阿拉斯加偏远山谷于2021年仍在使用的二战时期电话线路，展示了部分基础设施的长期耐用性以及偏远地区通信的实际挑战。

items.title_en: Rebuilding My Homelab with Compose, Ruby, IPv6, and No Kubernetes
items.title_zh: 用 Compose、Ruby、IPv6 构建我的家庭实验室，告别 Kubernetes
items.summary_en: An experiment in simplifying home infrastructure by dropping Kubernetes in favor of Docker Compose and Ruby tooling, with IPv6 support. The write-up shares pros, cons, and lessons learned about maintainability and control.
items.summary_zh: 在家庭服务器领域尝试用 Docker Compose 与 Ruby 脚本替代 Kubernetes，推动 IPv6 的落地与简化运维。总结这条简化路线的利与弊，以及对可维护性的影响。

items.title_en: Cottage Computer Programming (1984)
items.title_zh: 家庭式计算机编程（1984）
items.summary_en: Cottage Computer Programming (1984) revisits a bygone era of home-based programming culture, offering a snapshot of hobbyist computing practices, curiosities, and early DIY computing ethos.
items.summary_zh: 《家庭式计算机编程》（1984）回顾了家用编程文化的往昔，呈现业余计算实践、好奇心与早期 DIY 计算精神的缩影。

items.title_en: What's the story behind the names of Cloudflare's name servers? (2013)
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 名称服务器背后的故事（2013）
items.summary_en: The post uncovers how Cloudflare named its DNS servers, tying server labels to branding, internal culture, and practical ops considerations. It offers a window into early 2010s DNS infrastructure naming practices and why naming matters in large-scale networks.
items.summary_zh: 揭秘 Cloudflare 名称服务器的命名背后所受的品牌和运维文化影响。文章提供了早期 DNS 基础设施命名的历史视角，显示命名在规模化网络中的实际意义。

items.title_en: Helicone allows users to write SQL directly to a shared ClickHouse
items.title_zh: Helicone 允许直接对共享的 ClickHouse 写 SQL
items.summary_en: Helicone enables writing SQL directly to a shared ClickHouse instance, pointing to multi-tenant analytics workflows and improved collaboration on data queries.
items.summary_zh: Helicone 允许直接对共享的 ClickHouse 写 SQL，指向多租户分析工作流与协作查询的提升。

items.title_en: Optimizing Lua string literals to save 400 bytes
items.title_zh: 通过优化 Lua 字符串字面量节省 400 字节
items.summary_en: A micro-optimization post shows how rewriting Lua string literals can shave around 400 bytes from a script, illustrating the subtle tradeoffs between readability and size in constrained environments.
items.summary_zh: 一篇极小型优化的文章展示如何通过重写 Lua 字符串字面量在脚本中省下约 400 字节，揭示受限环境下可读性与代码体积之间的微妙权衡。
